summary.en: Haibara and Mitsuhiko are waiting for Conan, Ayumi, and Genta to arrive so that Mitsuhiko can properly read his Holmes story The Adventure of the Abbey Grange for the first time with his friends. As the kids are walking on the road, a cat stops by Haibara, which catches Mitsuhiko’s attention as well. The cat takes the two to a room, a room where another man is terrified because of a corpse. It takes much longer than usual for the police to know the corpse belongs to Daiki Fujinai.

victims.name: Daiki Fujinai
victims.causeOfDeath: Blunt force trauma to the head

suspects: Tomohiro Nojima, three robbers caught running in a hurry
